run_optimizer_benchmark: run a benchmark comparing nevergrad optimizers like CMA, PSO, and DE on a custom loss function
create_optimization_domain: create a nevergrad optimization domain using ng.p.Array with a specified shape and bounds
run_parallel_optimization: run parallel optimization trials using joblib Parallel and delayed across multiple optimizer runs
lookup_optimizer_from_registry: lookup and instantiate a nevergrad optimizer by name from ng.optimizers.registry
minimize_custom_loss_function: minimize a custom loss function using nevergrad optimizer minimize method and retrieve the optimal value
